money_cells_2026_08_14_ap_bill_overclaim.note: ap_bill blanket-required on 4 fleet leaves; verified live per leaf, not assumed. unit.detail.finance_linkage genuinely owns it (KEPT, real Built added): UnitFinanceLinkageTab.tsx renders EntityLink kind="bill" per row from listUnitLinkedFinancials, backed by GET /api/v1/accounting/units/:id/linked-financials -> a tenant+unit_id-scoped SELECT against accounting.bills. The other 3 own no accounting.bills data anywhere in their render path: roster.row.edit_unit (CreateUnitModal.tsx, reused for the roster row edit) has zero vendor_id/bill_id fields; unit.profile.maintenance's WO widgets (ServiceTimeline.tsx, UnitPartsHistorySection.tsx) surface work_order/vendor/vendor_invoice_number (a plain string, not an accounting.bills FK) but never a real bill_id or EntityLink kind="bill"; trailer.profile.maintenance (TrailerProfilePage.tsx) has zero bill references at all.

trailer_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: 8 of 38 fleet leaves are false: home.create_unit/fleet.modal.create_unit only create a truck unit, no trailer field; unit.profile.identity/unit.edit.identity are truck-only identity fields; unit.profile.current_load renders EntityLink kind="unit"/kind="load" but never trailer despite loads carrying a trailer assignment; unit.edit.reefer is a static read-only string pointing at a trailer id, not a real EntityLink/picker/editable field. roster.row.edit_trailer and transfers.in_progress were found broken (see the separate trailer_column_2026_08_14_bugfix honesty_audit entry) and fixed in this PR; both now correctly keep the trailer Required marking. The other 28 leaves KEEP the Required marking — TrailerProfilePage.tsx's 13 self-referential trailer.profile.* sections, trailer.status_change/trailer.edit, the roster kind/filter/bulk actions (real kind-branching on trailer rows), home.roster, home.create_trailer, fleet.modal.create_trailer/edit_trailer/quick_assign, and unit.profile.reefer (real attached-trailer reefer telemetry) all confirmed genuine.

trailer_column_2026_08_14_bugfix.note: roster.row.edit_trailer and transfers.in_progress both carried a WRONG 'unit' Required marking that exactly matched a real product bug, not a metadata drift: FleetTable.tsx's roster row Edit button always opened the unit-only EditVehicleModal regardless of row.kind (never branched to EditTrailerModal for trailer rows), and TransfersInProgressPage.tsx labeled every row 'Unit:' with EntityLink kind="unit" even though row.equipment_id is always sourced from mdata.equipment (trailer/chassis), never mdata.units. Both fixed in this PR's code changes (FleetTable.tsx now branches on row.kind to open EditTrailerModal for trailer rows; TransfersInProgressPage.tsx now renders 'Trailer:' / EntityLink kind="trailer"), and the Required marking corrected from the wrong 'unit' to the now-genuinely-true 'trailer', proven by scripts/verify-fleet-roster-trailer-edit-and-transfer-link.mjs.

customer_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: unit.profile.current_load renders "Customer: {name}" as plain inert text with no customer_id field or EntityLink kind="customer" — cosmetic, not real linkage.

vendor_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: 10 of 13 fleet leaves are false: the roster/create-unit/create-trailer/edit surfaces and unit/trailer identity tabs have zero vendor references; unit.edit.financial's qbo_vendor_id field degrades to a raw text input (no picker) in EditVehicleModal.tsx, distinct from the genuine picker on the profile page itself; trailer.profile.maintenance and trailer.edit have zero vendor wiring anywhere. unit.profile.maintenance (KEPT — real vendor via a backend LEFT JOIN mdata.vendors, shown as plain text but genuinely vendor-backed), unit.profile.qbo_mapping (KEPT — real QboCombobox entityType="vendor"), and unit.detail.finance_linkage (KEPT — real vendor_name alongside a real EntityLink kind="bill") all keep the Required marking.

unit_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: 12 of 62 fleet leaves are false: home.create_trailer/roster.kind.trailers/trailer.profile.*(4)/trailer.status_change/trailer.edit/fleet.modal.create_trailer/fleet.modal.edit_trailer are all trailer-only surfaces with zero unit_id (trailer.profile.identity/reefer/maintenance/safety_reverse are trailer-scoped self-reference, not unit); roster.kind.company never matches any row (UnifiedUnitRow.kind is typed truck|trailer only, permanently empty); map.redirect (MapView.tsx) only reads load_id/driver_id, no unit param. The other 50 leaves KEEP the Required marking — VehicleProfilePage.tsx's 26 self-referential unit.profile.* sections, all 8 unit.edit.* tabs, all 6 unit.detail.* tabs, real roster kind-branching for truck rows, trailer.profile.assignment (shows the real attached unit), and the unit-scoped modals.

driver_column_2026_08_14_overclaim.note: driver blanket-required on 13 fleet leaves. Verified live — FleetTable.tsx's roster grid (home.roster/roster.kind.trucks) has zero driver_id field/EntityLink/EntityPicker on-screen ("assigned driver" appears only in an Excel-export tooltip); CreateUnitModal.tsx/CreateTrailerModal.tsx/EditTrailerModal.tsx have no driver field at all; IdentityStatusHeader.tsx (unit.profile.identity) and CurrentLoadSection.tsx (unit.profile.current_load) only link kind="unit"/kind="load"; AssetSafetyReverseSection.tsx (unit.profile.safety_reverse) shows driver_name as PLAIN TEXT only, no driver_id/EntityLink; EditVehicleModal.tsx's "Identity" tab (unit.edit.identity) has no driver field — assigned_driver_id lives only on the separate Quick-availability tab; TasksTab.tsx (unit.detail.tasks) is scoped only to targetType="unit"; CurrentAssignmentSection.tsx (trailer.profile.assignment) shows only the attached truck and current load, no driver.

connectivity_column_2026_08_14.note: Vertical wiring sweep (connectivity column, after trailer/customer/vendor/unit/driver/load) read-only investigated every leaf blanket-marked Required for connectivity (nav->route->API->canonical). These leaves have no such chain: static/placeholder surfaces, pure client-side nav Links/redirects, or list-toolbar chrome (search/range/gear) whose shared component (ParityTable/UniversalListToolbar) filters an already-fetched client-side array with no independent backend round-trip. route-mount itself remains proven per-leaf by scripts/verify-wave-b-connectivity-all-modules.mjs; this correction is scoped to leaves where the deeper nav->route->API->canonical claim doesn't apply at all.
